title: Courage Week 1 Part 2
speaker: Heigaku Talus Latona
summary: Heigaku Talus Latona leads a guided sitting in Week 1 of a class on courage, using a worksheet of arcs drawn like the layers of an onion. With eyes closed, participants write the name of a fear in the top layer, such as fear of talking on the telephone or fear of conflict, greet it with "Hello, fear. I recognize you," and then peel back to what lies beneath. Toward the end, Heigaku offers Sharon Salzberg's teaching that the antidote to fear is kindness or gentle friendship, and invites everyone to treat their fears as friends who were invited over. The session closes with a round of sharing on three topics: gender, courage and fear, and where the class is headed.
